name: glowing-effect
title: Glowing Effect
description: A border glow that tracks the pointer: a card outline lights up with a short arc on the side facing the cursor and fades when the pointer moves away.
use: A grid of feature or pricing cards needs a subtle hover cue without changing the card layout.
avoid: The effect is decorative and pointer-only, so touch and keyboard users never see it.
a11y: The glow is pointer-only, so keyboard and touch users get no equivalent cue from this component. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five near-black cards in an uneven grid, each with a small icon in a bordered square, a bold white heading and grey supporting text. The hovered card's thin border shows a bright segment that fades into the rest of the outline.
behaves: As the pointer moves, a bright wedge of gradient travels around the border of the nearby card to face it, easing into place; leaving fades it back to a plain outline. The card itself never moves.
customise: Tune blur, proximity, spread, inactiveZone, border width, movement duration, variant and a disabled flag; the gradient palette itself is fixed in the source.
weight: light: One CSS mask with a short animation per pointer move, idle otherwise.
